title: Implement prompt cache scope and dynamic boundary strategy
objective: Upgrade Go prompt caching from basic cache_control markers to original-style static/dynamic scope handling.
context: Go already marks Anthropic system, tool, and message breakpoints.
The original splits system prompt blocks into attribution, CLI prefix, global static content, org-scoped content, and uncached dynamic content.
Dynamic prompt changes should not invalidate the static prompt cache.
deliverables: Add a SYSTEM_PROMPT_DYNAMIC_BOUNDARY equivalent or metadata-based boundary.
Mark static blocks with global or org cache scope where supported.
Mark dynamic blocks with null cache scope.
Implement fallback to org scope when global cache is not safe or when tool-based cache markers require it.
Teach Anthropic provider to convert block cache scopes into appropriate cache_control payloads.
Preserve existing single-string cache behavior as fallback.
acceptance: Tests prove dynamic block text changes do not alter static block cache metadata.
Anthropic provider emits cache_control only for eligible blocks.
OpenAI and Responses providers ignore cache scopes safely.
non_goals: Do not implement beta header latching unless already exposed by provider config.
Do not add billing or plan eligibility checks unless the repo already has that data.
handoff_notes: Update prompt/prompt-cache.md only if this task changes documented behavior; larger doc cleanup belongs to task_14.
